direct_risk_subgraph_rationale: This set is sufficient and minimal to capture the core structural conflict. bgb_275 (exclusion of duty) and bgb_283 (damages instead of performance when duty excluded) directly reference each other. bgb_280 is the nexus of the conflict: its annotation explicitly describes a 'non-curable enforcement conflict' arising if its 'opposite remedy class' is applied while an 'upstream classification' (logically from bgb_275 triggering bgb_283) is still in force. The cycle bgb_275 <-> bgb_280 and bgb_283 <-> bgb_280, along with the direct bgb_275->bgb_283 edge, creates a tight loop where the classification of the remedy (cure vs. surcharge) can become inconsistent. Adding more nodes (e.g., bgb_281, bgb_326) expands the context but does not change the fundamental conflict localized among these three.
